title: Great Ziggurat of Ur & Najaf Shrine
full_text:
We will drive to the historical city of Ur to visit the Great Ziggurat of Ur, a UNESCO world heritage site and the former capital of Mesopotamia during the Sumerian time. The site includes Abraham house, Sholgi palace, and the oldest arch of its kind in the world at the entrance of Dub-Lal-Makh temple. We also can witness one of the most beautiful sunsets.
Head to Najaf and we will walk to the area of the shrine of Imam Ali and will have the chance to visit the grand bazaar of Najaf.
